scope: Product-grade hardening audit for three demo recording flows
audit_note: This audit records code-level findings and the hardening path. Final READY_REAL status remains gated by S100P live acceptance reports.

matrix.product_gap: No new product-grade gap found in this pass; still requires live service checks before recording.
matrix.changes_required: Keep stage8_demo1_link_readiness_gate in final aggregate gate.

matrix.module: AI Space / Smart Classification / Smart Naming
matrix.product_gap: Usable as AI evidence source, but Auto Organizer needed explicit provenance fields.
matrix.changes_required: Expose source_priority, evidence_refs, and resolution_source through Auto Organizer plan items.

matrix.product_gap: Previous planner could fall back to filename heuristic without failing the product demo path.
matrix.changes_required: Add ai_index_resolver, block product fallback with ai_index_missing_for_asset, add top-level ai_driven/resolution_source/fallback_used fields, keep diagnostic fallback explicit.

matrix.product_gap: record_standard_trace remained available and was not visibly separated from product traces.
matrix.changes_required: Add AssistantTraceContext, mark standard traces synthetic, expose non_synthetic_trace_count and product_demo_allowed.

matrix.product_gap: Live query endpoints existed in the portal server, but route/service modules were not separated for audit.
matrix.changes_required: Add src/document_rag, src/ocr_index, src/openclaw/routes/document_rag_routes.py and product status ocr_rag card.

matrix.product_gap: Gate covered the flow but did not require top-level AI-driven plan fields or document-rag status.
matrix.changes_required: Strengthen stage9_demo2_real_user_flow_gate to check ai_driven/fallback_used/resolution_source and document-rag status.

matrix.product_gap: Gate checked payload_source but not synthetic_trace/product_demo_allowed.
matrix.changes_required: Strengthen stage9_demo3_real_trace_flow_gate to reject synthetic traces.

matrix.product_gap: Status card did not surface auto-organizer last AI plan, fallback blocker, rollback, or non-synthetic trace count.
matrix.changes_required: Add module metrics for auto organizer, assistant trace, and ocr_rag.

special_judgements.auto_organizer_ai_sources: Before hardening it had AI lookup helpers, but product output did not enforce AI evidence. This pass adds src/auto_organizer/ai_index_resolver.py and makes product fallback fail.
special_judgements.auto_organizer_filename_only: Filename heuristic remains only as explicit diagnostic fallback. Product demo plan returns ok=false, degraded=true, blocker=ai_index_missing_for_asset when AI evidence is missing.
special_judgements.assistant_trace_real_chain: Product chat path now uses AssistantTraceContext; record_standard_trace is marked synthetic_trace=true and product_demo_allowed=false.
special_judgements.stage8_stage9_status_only: Stage 8 remains diagnostic/coverage-oriented. Stage 9 gates now validate real plan fields, move/rollback, fallback blocking, document-rag status, and non-synthetic traces.
special_judgements.ocr_rag_query_endpoint: GET /api/document-rag/status, POST /api/document-rag/query, GET /api/ocr/status, POST /api/ocr/query, and POST /api/ocr/rebuild are routed or surfaced.
special_judgements.demo2_upload_to_rollback: Gate path covers media upload, indexing, search, RAG query, auto-organize plan/dry-run/approve/execute/rollback. Final status is pending S100P live gate.
special_judgements.demo3_three_queries_trace: Gate path covers local media, private docs, and public complex queries. Final status is pending S100P live gate.
